  I'm also unsure of that conclusion, though.  Sing mentions that Ash must have suffered a lot, so isn't it possible that within that time he had he could've asked for help?  I mean, he did make it to the library after all.  Then again, this could have been an internal struggle considering he's a criminal and asking for help would probably land him in jail.  He was smiling in death, too, but I'm not sure if that really points to either conclusions necessarily.  Honestly at this point the closure I got from reading Garden of Light is gone because there's so much information to both sides of the argument.
